member.param: The ID of the I2C bus to use.
The address of the I2C device.

The polarity setting for the first set of pins (0=Normal polarity, 1=Invert polarity).
The polarity setting for the first set of pins (0=Normal logic, 1=Invert logic).
The behavior setting for the second set of pins (0=Output, 1=Input).
The polarity setting for the second set of pins (0=Normal polarity, 1=Invert polarity).

The second byte to update the output memory.

member.name: M:GPIO.II2C.SetAllOutput(System.Int32)
member.summary: Sets the state of all output pins to either on or off.
member.param: An integer value indicating the desired state: 0 to turn all outputs off, 1 to turn all outputs on.
member.remarks: This method updates the output bytes and bits based on the specified state and then updates all outputs. If the device is not initialized, the method does nothing. Any exceptions during the process are caught and logged.

member.param: The value for output 0.
The value for output 1.

member.name: M:GPIO.II2C.SetAllOutput(System.Boolean[],System.Boolean[])
member.summary: Sets the output states for two sets of output bits.
member.param: An array of boolean values representing the first set of output bits.
An array of boolean values representing the second set of output bits.
member.remarks: This method copies the provided output states into internal buffers, converts them to byte format, and updates the device outputs. If the device is not initialized, the method does nothing. Any exceptions during the process are caught and logged.

member.name: M:GPIO.II2C.SetOutput(System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: Sets the state of a specific output pin.
member.param: The pin number to set the state for. Valid values are 0-15.
The state to set the pin to: 0 for off, 1 for on.
member.remarks: This method updates the state of the specified pin and then updates all outputs. If the device is not initialized, the method does nothing. Any exceptions during the process are caught and logged. Additionally, if the application is running in console mode, detailed logs are printed to the console.

An array to store the second set of input states.
member.remarks: This method reads the current input states from the device and copies them into the provided arrays. If the device is not initialized, the method does nothing. Any exceptions during the process are caught and logged.
